scopeDescriptions.agent:dispatch: ⚠ Lets external agents run your built-in/plugin subagents or characters headlessly (tool loop + model calls). Returned text is PII-redacted. Default OFF.
scopeDescriptions.agent:team: ⚠ Lets external agents start an Agent Team headlessly — a multi-agent orchestration they couldn't otherwise reach. Default OFF.
scopeDescriptions.inbound:write: ⚠ Lets external agents contribute lessons, skill drafts, and notes. Nothing is applied automatically — submissions land in a review queue as pending, untrusted drafts for you to accept or discard. Default OFF.
scopeDescriptions.inbox:connectors:read: ⚠ Read-only inbox introspection — adapters, conversations, drafts, audit. Metadata may include conversation handles and recent message snippets. Default OFF.
scopeDescriptions.inbox:connectors:send: ⚠ Lets external agents enqueue AI replies to your IM inbox. Goes through the same pipeline as in-app chat (PII gate, policy, outbound queue). Default OFF.
scopeDescriptions.mcp:computer-use: ⚠ Drives the host computer (mouse / keyboard / screenshot) from external coding agents. Honours Settings → Automation → Permissions; per-call tier surfaces the consent overlay.
scopeDescriptions.plugin:tools: ⚠ Lets external agents invoke your plugin-registered tools. The plugin's own consent gate + ownership check still apply per call. Default OFF.
scopeDescriptions.rag:twin: ⚠ Retrieval over your digital twin's chunks (personal documents / chat / code). Default OFF.
scopeDescriptions.rag:user-repo: Retrieval over user-supplied repos. Phase 3 — disabled.
scopeDescriptions.runtime:characters: ⚠ Exposes character configs (may contain personal prompts).
scopeDescriptions.runtime:plugins: Exposes the list and metadata of installed plugins.
scopeDescriptions.runtime:twins: ⚠ Exposes Twin profiles. PII redaction has run, but review before enabling.
scopeDescriptions.wiki:cognia: Public Cognia code wiki — safe to expose.
scopeDescriptions.wiki:user-repo: Wiki for user-supplied repos. Phase 3 — disabled in Phase 1.

scopes.description: Each scope is opt-in. Default install ships with only the public-code wiki scopes enabled.
